events.title: Wiesbaden Art Exhibition — Local Artists Showcase
events.description: The Wiesbaden cultural center hosts a rotating exhibition featuring works from local and regional artists. Paintings, sculptures, photography, and mixed-media installations across two floors. This month's theme explores 'Hessen Through the Seasons'. Artist talks every Saturday at 15:00. Small café on-site with local wines and cakes.

events.title: Rüsselsheim Wine & Cheese Tasting Festival
events.description: Celebrate Hessen's finest wines and cheeses at the Rüsselsheim wine festival. Sample Rieslings, Silvaners, and Spätburgunders from Rheingau and Hessische Bergstraße vineyards, paired with local cheeses. Expert sommeliers guide you through the pairings. Wine sales at festival prices. Live accordion music adds a festive atmosphere. Designated driver tickets (non-alcoholic) available.

events.title: Rüsselsheim Weekly Market & Farmers Market
events.description: The weekly market in Rüsselsheim transforms the city center into a vibrant marketplace. Local farmers from the surrounding Hessian countryside bring fresh organic produce, artisan cheeses, free-range eggs, freshly baked bread, and regional specialties. Flower stalls, honey from local beekeepers, and handcrafted goods add to the charm. Live music from 10:00-12:00. A true taste of Hessen's agricultural heritage.

events.title: Kinderfest in Darmstadt
events.description: A family-friendly festival in Darmstadt with face painting, balloon animals, puppet shows, craft stations, and a small petting zoo. Children can try pottery, painting, or building birdhouses. Parents enjoy coffee and cake at the parent lounge. Special storytelling sessions in German and English at 11:00 and 14:00. Recommended for ages 3-12.

events.title: Marburg Street Food Festival
events.description: Hessen's best street food vendors gather in Marburg for a weekend of culinary exploration. From traditional Handkäse mit Musik and Grüne Soße to international fusion cuisine, there's something for every palate. Cooking demonstrations, craft beer tastings, and live DJ sets throughout the day. Vegan and gluten-free options available.

events.title: Friedberg Book Fair & Literary Reading
events.description: Book lovers gather in Friedberg for a weekend celebration of literature. Local authors, publishers, and booksellers showcase new releases alongside classic Hessian literature. Featured readings in German and English. Children's storytelling corner, poetry slam, and writing workshops. Rare book dealers offer antique and collectible editions.

events.title: Offenbach Open-Air Cinema Night
events.description: The Offenbach open-air cinema returns with a curated selection of international and German films. Screenings begin at sunset (approx. 21:15). Bring blankets and cushions — seating is on the grass. Themed food nights: Italian, Asian, and Hessian cuisine. Rain contingency: screening moves to the indoor community hall next door.

events.title: Limburg Night Market
events.description: The Limburg night market transforms the old town into a magical evening destination. Artisan stalls, food vendors, and live performers line the cobblestone streets under fairy lights. Local winemakers from the Rheingau region offer tastings. Live jazz and acoustic sets on two stages. Runs until midnight. A perfect evening out in the heart of Hessen.

events.title: Bad Homburg Guided Nature Walk
events.description: Explore the natural beauty around Bad Homburg with a guided nature walk led by local park rangers. The 8km trail passes through forests, meadows, and along riverbanks, with expert commentary on local flora, fauna, and geology. Suitable for all fitness levels. Bring sturdy shoes, water, and weather-appropriate clothing. Dogs welcome on leash. Meeting point: Bad Homburg main train station at 09:00.

events.title: Hanau Summer Concert Series
events.description: The Hanau summer concert series returns with an evening of classical and contemporary music performed by the Hessian State Orchestra. Set in the beautiful Hanau park amphitheater, the program features works by Beethoven, Brahms, and modern Hessian composers. Pack a picnic and enjoy the music under the stars. Gates open 18:00, concert 19:30-21:30.
